record.question: Concept of Hospice is related to:
options: As association running orphanages for children
Special group of people helping the old and terminally ill patients
record.explanation: Answer D: Special group of people helping the old and terminally ill patients. Hospice provides supportive, palliative care for people with serious life-limiting illness and support for their families; it is not euthanasia. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/palliative-care. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
